# MuXu

> Embedded Linux consultancy — from board bring-up to production-certified software products.

MuXu are embedded Linux experts based in La Rioja, Spain. We help start-ups and hardware companies ship embedded Linux products — BSP development, OS customization, containerized applications, remote device management, computer vision, and edge AI.

## Services

- [Board Support Package](https://www.muxu.io/bsp): BSP development, kernel maintenance, device driver development and board bring-up across ARM platforms.
- [Operating System](https://www.muxu.io/os): Custom Linux distributions and production-grade OS builds using the Yocto Project and OpenEmbedded.
- [Containers](https://www.muxu.io/app): Container engine integration, application isolation and orchestration on embedded devices.
- [Remote Management](https://www.muxu.io/cloud): Fleet management, OTA updates, remote monitoring and diagnostics for embedded devices.
- [Computer Vision](https://www.muxu.io/cv): Camera integration, video processing pipelines, object detection and media streaming on embedded hardware.
- [Edge AI & IoT](https://www.muxu.io/ai): On-device AI inference, model optimization, neural network accelerator integration and IoT architecture.
